newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris repeated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris repeated as buy.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Martin Feldman said he reiterated a buy rating on Philip Morris Cos Inc.
-- said price fell unduly harshly on Friday, when stock dropped 5-3/8 to 92-1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange.
-- on Friday, there was a report indicating that scientists had identified a direct link between smoking and lung cancer.
-- said consumers and investors have long been aware of this link.
-- said tobacco sector equities, especially characterized by Philip Morris, are expected to have a "an extremely strong year" in 1997.
-- expects Philip Morris to generate total returns to shareholders in excess of 20 percent over next 12 months.
-- said expects stock price to recover.
